column1: # Each reader host's own GPG key fingerprint (public information).
# Generate the key on the host:
#   (then add an encryption subkey: gpg --quick-add-key <fpr> cv25519 encr never)
# Export the PUBLIC key to qbert (gpg --export <fpr> | ssh qbert gpg --import) and
# record the fingerprint below. Never put a private key anywhere in this repo.
